item.title: [paper] Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Cross-View Temporal Object Correspondence
item.description: XTrack is a unified framework that repurposes pretrained video diffusion transformers with specialized attention and cropping strategies to track object identity across views and time.

item.title: [paper] What Improves During Pretraining? Tracking Knowledge Acquisition with Point-in-Time Models
item.description: This research paper proposes a temporal variability score to track how language models acquire knowledge of varying consistency across different years of pretraining web text.
